title: reconcile-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that reconciles ISO 20022 camt.053 bank-statement entries against expected pain.001 payments. Provides explainable exact, partial, one-to-many and many-to-one matching with per-match scores and classification, tools to normalise both pain.001 and camt.053 inputs, single-pair match explanation for tuning, and built-in sandbox scenarios for zero-setup trials. Apache-2.0, pure Python over stdio.
